query:
SELECT u.user_type AS "user_type!",
               u.org_key_management_mode AS "mode!",
               uo.role AS "role?"
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN user_organizations uo
               ON uo.organization_id = u.id
              AND uo.user_id = $2
              AND uo.status = 'active'
        WHERE u.id = $1
